horoscope: The Moon is in the background in your solar chart today, dear Aries, and you might similarly seek some anonymity, alone time, or extra rest. Even so it's a good time for drawing upon your resources and talents and applying them. So while retiring in some way can be helpful for gathering yourself, you can also function well in the "real world" and come across pleasantly as you do.  Especially as the day advances, it can be a great time to birth new, creative ideas, as well as money-making ideas. Conditions are excellent for finding resolutions to matters causing you some amount of stress. It's particularly the case with romantic relationships, children, creative pursuits, or hobbies. You are ready to take steps to improve a situation! Taking the lead or taking charge becomes you, and you may very well find that others are attracted to your healing, proactive, and naturally confident approach. You tend to push yourself past your fears and embrace new ideas and opportunities.

Relationships can be up and down early today, dear Taurus, but clearing the air can push you towards growth. It would help if you had both quiet time and interactions with others, and finding the right balance is tricky but essential. As the day advances, it's a good time to come to a better understanding and a mature perspective on family matters, issues of the past, and how you deal with anger or resentment. You may need to release frustration now, and great energy is with you for doing so. Bonding with family and loved ones can occur through shared activities. Interactions are rich.

With today's Moon, dear Gemini, you are a little more ambitious, and this fuels your motivation. Early today, however, there can be an inclination to let something slide. Watch also for a tendency to take little things too personally. Ideally, conflicting feelings lead to creative workarounds and improvements, and you can learn a lot about what you can and cannot do. While today can get off to a stressful start, as the day advances, you're in particularly great shape for resolving recent problems related to communication, learning, or transportation, perhaps after some level of distress along these lines. You're ready to make the most of a situation! Confronting a problem, rather than sidestepping it, feels right at the moment. It's time to attract fresh, enlightening experiences.

There can be some problems getting your message across early today, dear Cancer, but it's temporary. While you can typically read a lot from an interaction, there are so many confusing signals right now that it's best to let it go. In truth, part of you wants to be a free spirit today, while another part wants to keep things steady, and compromise may be in order. As the day advances, wonderful energy is with you for resolving a business or money problem or an issue of respect or ownership in a relationship. The desire to put something behind you can lead to a confrontation that works in your favor or a hands-on approach to problem-solving. Being direct and honest can feel a little sticky now, but it can also be relieving and revealing.

See-sawing between different approaches and methods can lead to some division early today, dear Leo, and perhaps a lack of satisfaction. If you're going back and forth on an issue, take a break from thinking about it too intensely or from picking things apart. You may need some distance from the matter to gain perspective. Nevertheless, this is a good day for learning about others' beliefs or interesting new topics and ideas. As the day advances, transits stir you to explore and discover. Something that had you worked up makes a little more sense, and you're ready to take positive action to make improvements. Stronger conviction is with you if you find more meaning in what you are doing.

Others are naturally more cooperative with you today, dear Virgo. You may be feeling a tad off your game early today, however, and the past has a way of pulling you in. Still, small personal triumphs can still be had and enjoyed, particularly private ones. Matters of power or trust may be a big deal today, but you may be able to see through them well enough to be able to make improvements. As the day progresses, you may feel more settled and better able to understand a private, personal, or past matter, and you may have the chance to release a burden. You might make more sense of your feelings or a situation, or connect with an attitude or fear that has held you back. It can feel good to be more self-aware.

Early today, you can find yourself indecisive or restless, dear Libra, and there can be a feeling that you're missing or avoiding something important. The trick is to avoid doing too many things at once, or juggling too many ideas at the same time. Try to approach things one step at a time. Transits today and tomorrow inspire your need for companionship, feedback, or a different perspective. As the day advances, dilemmas with friends, associates, or long-term goals may resolve, or your path may become clearer as you better understand a situation, leading you to take action. Improvement and moving on are in focus. At the same time, energies with you now encourage you to do so mindfully, not by ignoring problem areas but by facing them head-on.

Early today, doubts or concerns may prevent you from interacting naturally, dear Scorpio, or could leave you feeling a bit restless. Keep yourself open to possibilities and to making changes, but don't shake things up just for the sake of it, as it may not be the time for big moves. Especially as the day advances, issues related to work, career, reputation, or responsibilities seem to clear up or make sense. Alternatively, you resolve to deal with a situation that's frustrated you in recent days and move on. It's a good time to release tension and take steps toward healing, improvement, and growth. Efforts to improve work or health are paying off and making you feel good right now.

Early today, you could feel some pressure from others, which can bring on impulsiveness, dear Sagittarius. You might decide to focus on getting rid of things that you no longer need or, perhaps more importantly, that leave you feeling weighed down. Adjustments in the ways you approach others - how and what you communicate - may be necessary now. As the day advances, challenges related to moving out of your comfort zone, learning, or publishing can clear. Instead, you seem to know the path to take to move forward. You can feel at peace with the past or with your deeper wishes and desires.

While you can enjoy some enthusiasm early today, dear Capricorn, you should be careful not to burn yourself out or let some areas of your life slide in the process. Sometimes you need to build up both physical and mental strength, if only to get back to what you love to do. While the early day can be tense or restless, as the day advances, it's easy to make sense of a tricky situation, allowing you to move on. Taking action feels satisfying now, and it's about growing and improving, particularly in relationships, money matters, and family or home affairs. It's a good time to release a burden or heal a grievance. You are braver about facing your fears, which can lead to real, useful solutions to problem areas.

You could be feeling good about others who are putting their faith in you today, dear Aquarius, but could also feel overwhelmed by extra demands or pressures. However, it's a strong time to sort out tricky emotional matters and problems. You can be especially resourceful, especially as the day advances. Partnering up can work well right now, particularly when it comes to solving problems or working out a game plan. While there can be early-day tensions, you're in a great position to accept or resolve a relationship matter that may have caused you some recent stress. You're inclined to want to take action on a matter rather than hold onto it, which can mean talking through a problem with someone and releasing pent-up worries or frustrations.

The day's energies play well to your natural temperament, dear Pisces. Early today, people around you may not be as reliable as you'd like. As the day advances, this can be a good time for making real headway on tasks that you normally might find too monotonous. Detail work can thrive right now. You have a strong sense of the future in a practical way today. You could feel a little torn between wanting to try new things and preferring to stick with what's most comfortable and secure, and a compromise, if you can manage it, makes sense. In fact, you can find yourself in a great position to resolve recent problems related to work, health, routines, or daily affairs. You're in particularly good shape to find ways to heal, whether in your mind, your body, or both.
